target.title: fix(browser): check own profile entries for profile operations
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves
Browser profile names are user-controlled config keys. The profile service and config patch path treated inherited properties as existing entries, so a valid profile name such as `constructor` could be rejected, dropped, or fail to round-trip correctly. The fix uses own-property checks for profile existence while preserving the existing prototype-pollution guard for nested unsafe keys.

## Summary
- Use own-property checks when browser profile create/delete operations test whether a profile key already exists.
- Preserve a real `browser.profiles.constructor` record while continuing to strip nested prototype-pollution keys from config patches.
- Add regression coverage for browser profile service, config write preparation, merge patch handling, and the gateway `config.patch` path.

## Evidence
- Head: `4b58ecbdb1`
- Node: `v22.22.0`
- `git diff --check upstream/main...HEAD` - passed
- `node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p test/tsconfig/tsconfig.core.test.json --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile .artifacts/tsgo-cache/core-test.tsbuildinfo` - passed
- `node_modules/.bin/vitest run --config test/vitest/vitest.runtime-config.config.ts src/config/merge-patch.proto-pollution.test.ts --reporter verbose` - passed, 1 file / 6 tests
- `node_modules/.bin/vitest run --config test/vitest/vitest.extension-browser.config.ts extensions/browser/src/browser/profiles-service.test.ts --reporter verbose` - passed, 1 file / 18 tests
- `OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_PROJECT_SHARDS=0 node_modules/.bin/vitest run --config test/vitest/vitest.gateway.config.ts src/gateway/server.config-patch.test.ts -t "persists and deletes a browser profile named constructor through config.patch" --reporter verbose` - passed, 1 selected test / 36 skipped

Browser profile route proof on head `4b58ecbdb1`, using a temporary `HOME`/`OPENCLAW_CONFIG_PATH`, a real Express route registration, and HTTP calls to `POST /profiles/create` and `DELETE /profiles/constructor`:

```json
{
  "createStatus": 200,
  "createOk": true,
  "createdProfile": "constructor",
  "persistedOwnConstructorAfterCreate": true,
  "deleteStatus": 200,
  "deleteOk": true,
  "persistedOwnConstructorAfterDelete": false,
  "objectPrototypePolluted": null
}
```

Gateway `config.patch` proof on head `4b58ecbdb1`, using the focused gateway RPC test path with nested blocked keys in the submitted profile:

```json
{
  "createPatchOk": true,
  "persistedOwnConstructorAfterCreate": true,
  "persistedCdpPort": 18991,
  "nestedConstructorStripped": true,
  "nestedPrototypeStripped": true,
  "objectPrototypePolluted": null,
  "removePatchOk": true,
  "persistedOwnConstructorAfterRemove": false
}
```
